tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that deliver to, or offer pickup near, a US location. Returns restaurant_id, cuisines, distance when a street address is given, Yelp rating when one is on file, and the restaurant page URL. Ask for a ZIP code, city and state, or street address before calling if you do

tools.name: search_caterers
tools.description: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that offer catering near a US location. Same results as search_restaurants with catering true. Use this for office meals, platters, and catering orders. Returns restaurant_id values get_menu can open with menu_type "catering".

tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Read the status of a BringMeThat order, including a guest order that is still being placed. Does not change the order. Needs the order number (starts with R) and the email used at checkout; details are returned only when both match.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_restaurants" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find restaurants on BringMeThat that deliver to, or offer pickup near, a US location. Returns restaurant_id, cuisines, distance when a street address is given, …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_restaurants, get_order_status, get_premium_signup_link · Private data: search_restaurants · Public sink: get_order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_restaurants, get_order_status, get_premium_signup_link · Private data: search_restaurants · Public sink: get_order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
